learning_outcomes.text: At the end of this course unit, the student is able to communicate with third parties about computer infrastructure.
The student can select which technologies are most suitable for certain cases and explain soundly why these technologies are most suitable for those cases.

syllabus_topics: Types of memory and their operation
Structure and operation of hard drives and their interfaces (classic, SSD, SAS and SATA)
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a written exam counting for 100%. There are no partial transfers for this course. Resit opportunities are provided during the third examination period (August) as a written exam, also counting for 100%.
